title: SoulShake
description:
Purchase NoticeThis is a horror game with no saved single player experience. You will walk through a terrifying abandoned hospital from a first person perspective, exploring its past and why you appeared in this abandoned hospital.
There are not many scary points in the game settings, so you can consider it as a walking simulator for an abandoned hospital.storyAfter waking up, you were locked in the basement of a eerie abandoned hospital. You need to find a way to leave the hospital and understand why you appeared in the hospital.
Game Time1 Hour to 1.5 HoursDecryptThe game decryption content is very simple. Follow the prompts to find the corresponding door key in order to get closer to the truth
description_short: After waking up, you will find a way to escape from an abandoned hospital in the basement and figure out what happened.
